intro: Lesotho is a constitutional monarchy with an elected parliament.

chapters.title: How it works
text: King Letsie III is head of state. The prime minister, Sam Matekane since 2022, leads the government.

chapters.title: South Africa
text: Lesotho depends heavily on South Africa for trade and jobs.

keyTerms.meaning: A monarch reigns under a constitution.
